disclaimer: Named options are starting points, not endorsements. LLM versions change every few months: confirm the current version, pricing, and your contract terms before relying on any entry.

RULES.name: Native ERP configuration
RULES.note: SAP S/4HANA and Oracle ship configurable checks (tolerances, credit rules, validations). Use them before building anything.

RULES.name: DMN decision tables
RULES.note: Camunda or Drools when rules must live outside the ERP and be owned by the business.

FUZZY.name: RapidFuzz
FUZZY.note: Fast string similarity for names and references.

FUZZY.name: Splink
FUZZY.note: Probabilistic record linkage with explainable match weights.

FUZZY.name: Native ERP matching rules
FUZZY.note: Most ERPs support rule-based auto-matching. Measure its rate first.

TABML.name: LightGBM
TABML.note: Fast gradient-boosted trees; strong default for tabular data.

TABML.name: XGBoost
TABML.note: Equivalent alternative with broad platform support.

TABML.name: CatBoost
TABML.note: Handles many categorical fields (customer, material, plant) with less preprocessing.

TABML.name: SHAP
TABML.note: Per-prediction reason codes for audit and user trust.

TABML.name: Logistic regression
TABML.note: Baseline to beat, and the fallback when explainability requirements are strict.

ANOM.name: PyOD
ANOM.note: Library of detectors to benchmark once reviewers have labeled some flags.

TS.name: MLForecast with LightGBM
TS.note: Global ML model across many series with external drivers.

TS.name: Chronos / TimesFM
TS.note: Time-series foundation models. Benchmark as challengers, not defaults.

OPT.name: Google OR-Tools (CP-SAT)
OPT.note: Scheduling, assignment, and routing with complex constraints.

OPT.name: Gurobi / IBM CPLEX
OPT.note: Commercial solvers for large MIP models.

OPT.name: Pyomo / PuLP
OPT.note: Modeling layer so the model is solver-independent.

DOCAI.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence (prebuilt invoice)
DOCAI.note: Prebuilt invoice and receipt models with field confidence.

DOCAI.name: Docling
DOCAI.note: Self-hosted document parsing when data cannot leave your environment.

SMALL.name: SetFit
SMALL.note: Few-shot fine-tuning of small encoders from a few hundred labels.

SMALL.name: Fine-tuned ModernBERT or DeBERTa-v3
SMALL.note: Higher accuracy with thousands of labels; runs on CPU or a small GPU.

RAG.name: Hybrid search (BM25 + vectors)
RAG.note: OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or Postgres with pgvector. Policy language needs exact-term matching as well as semantic search.

RAG.name: Reranker
RAG.note: Cross-encoder reranking to put the right clause first.

AGENTRO.name: MCP servers with read-only scopes
AGENTRO.note: Expose ERP/TMS lookups as narrow tools, not raw database access.

AGENTACT.name: MCP servers with per-tool approval
AGENTACT.note: Separate read and write tools; writes require approval and carry value limits.

LLMEXT.name: Structured output / JSON schema mode
LLMEXT.note: Force a fixed schema; reject and retry on schema failure.
